shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' lib/products.ts; do echo \"FILE "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'test -d node_modules && echo installed || echo missing; git status --short; ls -la'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log(require('react/package.json').version, typeof r.ViewTransition, typeof r.addTransitionType)\"; rg -n --glob '*.d.ts' 'viewTransition\\??|viewTransition:' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const n=require('next/package.json'); console.log(n.version, n.peerDependencies)\"; rg -n 'ViewTransition' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* -g 'package.json' | head"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react version && npm view next@16.4.2 peerDependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react@19.3.1 version && npm view react-dom@19.3.1 version && npm view @types/react version'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'which chromium || which chromium-browser || which google-chrome || true; npm ls @playwright/test playwright puppeteer --depth=0 || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --no-save --package-lock=false playwright && npx playwright install chromium'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package-lock.json'); console.log(p.packages[''].dependencies, p.packages['node_modules/next'].version, p.packages['node_modules/react'].version)\"; node -e \"console.log(require('next/package.json').version, require('react/package.json').version)\"; git status --short"
